notes.title: Cafe Haven Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone!

I am super pleased to announce that Cafe Haven has officially released!

For those of you wishing to buy this game or who have already bought it, just thought I would give you a heads up that Cafe Haven is releasing in a ‘complete’ state. This means I am not looking to add any additional content to the game, what you see is what you get. I will however, be paying attention to the game post launch and fixing any bugs or performance issues that arise.

Some of you may have been following the journey of this game, but for those of you who haven’t. This is my first ‘premium’ game that I will be shipping after going into indie development full time. I streamed majority of the process on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/flowstategamestv]Twitch[/url] and gave access to playtest builds to people on my [url=https://discord.gg/Zv9YvwYSRs]Discord[/url].

I will be taking a couple of weeks off to reset but will be jumping back into the development of a brand new game! As previously mentioned, you can follow the development of that game through my [url=https://www.twitch.tv/flowstategamestv]Twitch[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/Zv9YvwYSRs]Discord[/url].

Speaking of Discord, if you do join it, I have dedicated channels for Cafe Haven so if you ever wanted to chat about it or report a bug, it is the best place to do so!

I hope you all have as much fun playing Cafe Haven as I had making it, and I look forward to chatting to you all again soon!

-Ethan Fitzgerald (Grousey)

notes.title: Cafe Haven Releases In 1 Week
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone!

I am just writing up this post to let everyone know that Cafe Haven is now 1 week from release!

I have been hard at work with QA and polish to ensure a seamless experience for anyone that plays! I will talk more about the game in the release post in a weeks time, but just an early heads up. This game ships in it's complete state with no new content looking to be added to it. Post launch I will still be checking in on the game and fixing any bugs or performance issues. But pretty much, what you see is what you get.

Cafe Haven is scheduled to release on the 28th of February at 8:00AM AEST (27th February 2:00PM PST)  and I look forward to everyone getting to play the game! 

-Ethan Fitzgerald (Grousey)
